prompts: Analyze which vendor API supports this constraint
During Shape, verify this library assumption
research.required: Shape and Analyze reach a bounded research reference; primary/current evidence, uncertainty and source-to-decision implications are preserved; findings alone do not authorize implementation or frozen acceptance changes.

prompts: Recap the completed fix; we have a passing local check but no screenshot or deployed verification
writing.required: Reach technical writing and anti-rhetoric guidance; recap covers supported goal, changes, validation, result and limitations without requiring screenshots or inventing production impact.

prompts: Add or refresh an external skill
inventory.required: Audit uses read-only list/doctor; explicit bootstrap uses additive shared-engine sync and post-doctor; membership changes use shared engine, licensing/provenance checks, source-specific ownership, runtime-owned exclusions and restart notice.

prompts: Review my tasks while Notion access is unavailable
secondbrain.required: Default brief covers Now/Waiting/Stale/Ideas/next actions; weekly covers overdue and missing next steps, deals and ideas decisions; both use existing Tasks/Deals/Ideas schema, distinguish observations from proposals, never write from review-only authorization and never invent inaccessible state.

prompts: Critique this dashboard with pending annotations
Suggest a UI approach, but the preferred specialist is unavailable
ui.required: Meta skill inspects UI/design system then selects Impeccable for critique/design and ReUI for registry/API needs, both only if useful; catalog records provenance/purpose/limitations/selection; lifecycle/frontend/specialist ownership stays distinct; critique avoids edits/install/publish/annotation changes; authorized implementation continues; missing specialist is disclosed and alternatives are bounded; ordinary tasks do not require whole-catalog loading or new tool discovery. Annotation and component-specific handoff guidance remains reachable.
